title: Test-run card: update cards outside the in-memory transcript window; mirror remote testRunCardUpdated
outcome: Follow-up to tm-ncc6.13.1 (slice 2 changeset 2a). An idle session keeps only its last 64 messages in memory (SESSION_IN_MEMORY_MESSAGE_LIMIT, trim_persisted_session_tails) and only that window is written back (write_serialized_persisted_messages keeps the cold prefix). A card whose message has left the window (test_run_card_lookup -> Cold) is not updated in 2a: map entry kept, card keeps its last snapshot (documented in docs/features/test-runs.md 'The in-memory window'; test a_card_outside_the_in_memory_window_is_not_updated_yet). Plan: outside the state lock, read the cold row by (session_id, message_id) from SQLite, compare its run snapshot, UPDATE value_json/overview_kind for position < message_start_index under the SQLite writer lock, then commit a revision and publish testRunCardUpdated with the global message index (clients use the retained-message/resync fallback); drop the map entry when the row is gone. Also: remote_delta_apply consumes a remote TestRunCardUpdated without mirroring it into the proxied transcript (like TestRunChanged); mirror it like ParallelAgentsUpdate (hydration, replay key, streaming commit) with a remote test.
